statement: A single horizontal branch section in mixed characteristic gives rank-zero positive-genus vertical components after an actual Kummer base change; a p-group one-point cover of a good positive-genus rank-zero base has potential good Jacobian reduction of special p-rank zero.
notes: Full root, DE and PBC proof/source audits PASS. Horizontal characteristic-zero Abhyankar is separate from vertical ramification. Actual semistable-model map and positive-component domination are proved. Global main components use Raynaud Proposition 1 only away from the horizontal section, followed by smooth Deuring–Shafarevich. No generic cusp-path conclusion follows without further hypotheses.
